.NET MAUI 11.0.10

.NET MAUI 11.0.10 Release Notes

.NET MAUI 11.0.10 introduces significant improvements across all platforms with focus on quality, performance, and developer experience. This release includes 370 commits with various improvements, bug fixes, and enhancements.

Ai Agents

  • Add probability-scored duplicate issue detection by @kubaflo in #39218

Animation

  • Fix AnimationManager.Dispose — retained ticker keeps disposed manager and callbacks alive by @HarishwaranVijayakumar in #37639

    🔧 Fixes
    • [leak-scan] AnimationManager.Dispose — retained ticker keeps disposed manager and callbacks alive

  • Fix AnimationExtensions.Insert — disposed non-starting manager leaves callback statically rooted by @KarthikRajaKalaimani in #37572

🔧 Fixes
  • [leak-scan] AnimationExtensions.Insert — disposed non-starting manager leaves callback statically rooted

API

  • [api] Mark .NET 11 GA APIs as shipped on main by @kubaflo in #39807

entry.title: MessagePack-CSharp/MessagePack-CSharp - Releases - 2026-11-11
entry.content:
v4.0.0-rc.1

This is the release candidate of v4.

v4 is a ground-up redesign: more than twice the performance, stronger security by default, full Native AOT support, and many new features, including support for C# 15 union types. It is feature-compatible and wire-compatible with v3, but contains breaking changes; see the v4 README and its "Migrating from v3" section before upgrading.

.NET 11 has been released, and this version is built with its release SDK. Unless something major comes up, the next release will be v4.0.0.

Please report any problems in the Issues.

Changes since preview.2

New

  • [MessagePackObject(EnumAsString = true)] writes the enums of a type by name.

Behavior changes

  • Nullable annotations are enforced by default (ValidateNullableAnnotations), on both serialization and deserialization. The SignalR hub protocol's default options leave it off.
  • A constructor parameter that the payload omits takes its declared default value.
  • Typeless: a non-generic class derived from Collection<T>, List<T>, Dictionary<K, V> and the like is written the way v3 wrote it, each element with its type name, and payloads written by v3 for such a class are readable again (#2321).
  • An int key above 65,535 is an error (MsgPack008), and MaxBufferedMessageSize must be positive.
  • The reflection tier writes the same bytes as the source generator for a type that overrides a property in map mode.
  • Analyzers: MsgPack101 / MsgPack108 report CultureInfo, TimeZoneInfo, System.Type and ExpandoObject, which no default chain serves; MsgPack113 / MsgPack115 follow a container read into a helper method.

Dependencies

  • SerializerFoundation 1.4.1 and NativeCompressions 1.3.2.
  • The netstandard assets require Microsoft.Bcl.AsyncInterfaces and System.IO.Pipelines 8.0.0 instead of 10.0.0.

WinUI 3 in WinAppSDK 2.6.6-experimental 🧪

This is the WinUI 3 release that ships as part of Windows App SDK 2.6 Experimental. It extends the experimental TableView and Chart controls, lets scrolling content render outside its viewport, and includes accessibility and reliability fixes. It also carries forward the changes from Windows App SDK 2.6.5 stable.

What's new

  • TableView hierarchy and live data. TableViewSource.ParentBy builds hierarchical rows, and IsLiveShaping keeps sorting, filtering, grouping, and hierarchy up to date as item properties change. The control also adds cell and column-header context menus, row expansion APIs and automation support, and improvements to high-contrast rendering and column resizing.
  • Chart accessibility. ChartAutomationPeer and chart parts add UI Automation support to the experimental Chart control.
  • Scrolling content outside bounds. ScrollView.CanContentRenderOutsideBounds and ScrollPresenter.CanContentRenderOutsideBounds let apps opt out of viewport clipping so content can render outside the bounds. Both properties default to false.
  • Accessibility and reliability fixes. This release improves InkToolbar and InkCanvas accessibility and display scaling, fixes missing InkToolbar translations (microsoft/microsoft-ui-xaml#12162), and improves Window.Width and Window.Height behavior after a window closes. It also fixes a Flyout theme crash (microsoft/microsoft-ui-xaml#12089), ContentDialog and MenuFlyout issues with OptimizeApplyStyles enabled (microsoft/microsoft-ui-xaml#11257), and custom dependency properties being lost when XAML shuts down and restarts.

To see everything that's new and changed across the whole release, see the full Windows App SDK 2.6 Experimental release notes.

  • Download and update the WinUI Gallery to see the WinUI 3 updates firsthand.

WinUI 3 in WinAppSDK 2.6.5

WinUI 3 in Windows App SDK 2.6.5 picks up runtime hotfixes for rendering, window composition, system backdrops, and packaged app installation. It is available through the Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK 2.6.5 NuGet package.

  • Fixed an E_NOINTERFACE crash when enabling the System Composition Engine on Windows builds without the required interfaces. The runtime now uses the lifted compositor on those builds.
  • Reverted the system backdrop change introduced in 2.6.4 to address wrong-thread exceptions. System backdrops for content islands and XAML windows are not supported when using the System Composition Engine in this release.
  • Fixed an issue where app-extension registration metadata generation returned E_NOTIMPL, which could prevent packaged apps from installing.

coreunstable-1.21.0-beta.1

The following changes are from the previous release 1.20.1-beta.1.

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Exporter.Prometheus.AspNetCore v1.21.0-beta.1

    • Fixed OpenMetrics scrape responses containing a # UNIT line whose unit is
      not an underscore-separated suffix of the metric family name (for example
      auth.failedlogins with the unit logins), which caused scrapers such as
      Prometheus to reject the whole response. The # UNIT line is now omitted
      for such metrics; exported metric names are unchanged.
      (#7993)

    • Fixed scrapes that negotiate different response formats within the
      ScrapeResponseCacheDurationMilliseconds window each triggering their own
      metrics collection. A collection now also writes the response for other
      formats whose scrapes arrived alongside a previous collection, so scrapes
      that keep arriving together are served from the cache. Fresh cached responses
      remain available while another format is serialized, even if that
      serialization fails.
      (#7994)

    • Fixed array- and map-valued attributes being serialized as the .NET type
      name (e.g. System.Byte[], System.Int32[]) instead of being JSON-encoded
      as per the specification. byte[]-valued attributes are now
      Base64-encoded, and other array- and map-valued attributes are now
      JSON-encoded.
      (#7694)

    • Fixed arrays of string-valued key/value pairs being
      serialized as JSON arrays of strings instead of JSON objects.
      (#7694)

    • Fixed scrape clients which stop reading their response delaying other
      scrapes until ScrapeResponseTimeoutMilliseconds elapses.
      (#8041)

    • Breaking Change Dropped support for net8.0 and net9.0.

      remain available while another format is serialized, even if that
      serialization fails.

      name (e.g. System.Byte[], System.Int32[]) instead of being JSON-encoded
      as per the specification. byte[]-valued attributes are now
      Base64-encoded, and other array- and map-valued attributes are now
      JSON-encoded.
      (#7694)

      serialized as JSON arrays of strings instead of JSON objects.
      (#7694)
